headlineDefault: Technical Architect | Technical Lead — .NET, Cloud & Distributed Systems
summaryDefault: Technical Architect and Technical Lead with 15+ years designing distributed, cloud-native platforms and leading engineering teams to deliver them, across healthcare, retail, and telecom. Owns end-to-end architecture decisions across service boundaries, API contracts, event-driven messaging (Kafka/RabbitMQ), data models, and deployment topology on AWS and Azure, spanning multiple internal and partner-facing systems. Equally comfortable leading cross-functional engineering teams day-to-day — setting technical direction, running code reviews, mentoring engineers, and owning delivery through CI/CD. Deep hands-on background in .NET Core, C#, and Kubernetes/Docker-based deployment, with a track record translating business requirements into scalable, maintainable system design and shipped software.

roles.title: Principal Analyst (Technical Architect)
bullets: Own end-to-end architecture decisions for scalable microservices spanning multiple internal and partner-facing systems, built on .NET Core and AWS.
Architected 20+ microservices and 50+ REST APIs for distributed building-data platforms, serving millions of users across multiple product lines.
Improved application performance by 20% through architecture and database optimization; reduced infrastructure costs by 20% through cloud optimization.
Lead backend architecture reviews and mentor engineers across teams, establishing consistent design standards.

roles.title: PS IV Engineer (Technical Architect)
bullets: Architected enterprise POS backend services on .NET Core and Azure for high-volume, transaction-heavy retail environments.
Designed event-driven architecture using Kafka to support high-throughput transaction processing across distributed services.
Solved concurrent message delivery issues using SemaphoreSlim, improving reliability of payment and transaction workflows under peak load.

roles.title: Technical Lead
bullets: Led a team of 10 engineers delivering an enterprise-scale, cloud-native healthcare platform built on microservices architecture.
Architected and built scalable backend services using .NET Core and Scala supporting enterprise healthcare workflows.
Directed containerized deployment strategy using Docker and Kubernetes, improving deployment consistency across environments.
Reduced deployment time from 2 hours to 15 minutes (87.5% improvement) by automating CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins.

roles.title: Senior Consultant / Project Lead
bullets: Built an enterprise application from scratch as project lead — owning architecture, technical design, implementation, and deployment.
Drove code review standards and object-oriented design practices across the team to maintain design and code quality.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Developed backend services for the Ericsson media delivery platform using .NET Core, supporting large-scale media delivery workloads.
Implemented scalable microservices architecture for high-throughput content delivery, collaborating closely with cross-functional delivery teams.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer / Technical Lead
bullets: Led a development team building POS systems using .NET Core, React, and RabbitMQ for enterprise retail clients, owning delivery from design through release.
Built and scaled APIs and messaging systems supporting high-volume enterprise retail applications.
Guided junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews and technical mentoring, raising team-wide coding standards.

roles.title: Senior Developer

Optimized database performance and backend service design, improving system responsiveness.
